steps.note: Mixed into sweetened condensed milk, as in Daniel Peter’s crumb method.
Dried to a hard, brittle, crumb-like powder, and the Maillard browning gives it a cooked caramel flavour.
The crumb is melted back into a paste with more cocoa butter.

sources.text: The crumb method of milk chocolate from condensed milk, from this article; it gives no temperatures or times for the drying or conching.
